World/cell/catalogues and effect scheduler remain controlled.

Controlled replacement weapon/tag/token content is explicit. Sixty seconds is the authored fixture formula 20*grade, not a conversion of historical event units; exact stock prototype statistics, historical timing conversion and installed spell sessions remain pending.

This adapter owns exactly one unscripted plain holdable/melee/salvage item. Quantity one, no skin/load string, no ordinary morph or GameItem default hooks/wield scripts. Food, liquid capacity/mixing, HoveringLight wear support, generated NPC equipment and complex payload/components remain mandatory stock work.

Native economy evidence invokes Shop stock/sale/nested-purchase refusal methods with an uninitialized native shop and strict mocked payment; it proves the early guard, not a complete installed merchant transaction. Actual native salvage product creation is refused for the created weapon.

Expiry retains unloaded/mismatched persisted custodians and dependencies with recoverable diagnostics. Loaded native body/container custody can retire atomically with typed rollback; foreign effects, unknown hosts/references and unadapted topology hold. Automatic offline host loading is not claimed.

Native provider-fault acceptance covers final owned item DELETE, ordinary save and fresh custody reload, then exact retry. Native callbacks introducing death effects and lodged foreign value are refused with original custody conserved. Arbitrary uncaptured callback saves remain outside the bounded contract.

Death observers are guarded once for a live held item attempt. That flag is in-memory; manual Die callback behavior across restart is not qualified. Normal expiry reconciliation retries exact Delete rather than death notification.

Paid postcommit publication failure remains casting NeedsReview with no replay/refund. Its exact temporary output expires safely; broad alternate-body/route N25, permanent placement recovery and installed release qualification remain pending.

N21 is controlled-native dependency qualification; no Armageddon stock installer or stock Flame Knife has been authored. Storm Spear automatic primary-hand placement and actual native weapon combat profile/payload need later stock-facing work.
Inherited N14/N15 bounded native qualification and N16 sixteen-cycle partial qualification remain unchanged. Installed stock and high-volume/every-cycle restart are not run.

Corpse animation, canonical projections, occupied topology, eight larger features, Mount riding, Guardian guarding/counts, Gate follower risk/control/count and Courier delivery remain mandatory. Optional configuration generalization is conditional on actual stock need.
Earlier admission connection failure instantaneous cause remains unknown; later same-input retry is not root-cause proof.
